name: skill-video
description: Two skills. video-editor: edit a video of any genre from one or several rushes and B-roll, or create one from scratch in motion design, with a local review studio, editing rule packs per genre and synthesized sound. media-generator: generate and edit images, videos, voices, music and sounds through model routers (Kie.ai by default, or OpenRouter; Suno and Lyria among their models), voices with their captions, voice change, dubbing, voice design, sound effects, music, stems and transcripts straight from ElevenLabs, from a local dashboard or from prompts, every cost shown

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Optional: Scribe v2 transcript, voice-over, music and sound effects by ElevenLabs, and media-generator's voices, dialogues, voice change, dubbing, voice design, sound effects, music, stems and transcripts, straight from ElevenLabs. Empty: local Whisper, no voice-over, synthesized sound

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: media-generator: the other model router, for its models (Settings › Router). Empty: Kie.ai only

kie_api_key.title: Kie.ai API key
kie_api_key.description: media-generator: the default model router (Settings › Router picks the active one). Empty: switch the router to OpenRouter in Settings › Router

openrouter_management_key.title: OpenRouter management key
openrouter_management_key.description: Optional, media-generator: shows the account's balance. Empty: the API key's own limit only
